description: This Swift source file provides a static enum 'OpenClawConfigFile' that manages configuration data for the OpenClaw application. It includes functions for loading, saving, updating, and auditing configuration files, along with handling remote gateway URLs, metadata, and suspicious activity detection related to configuration integrity.

methods.name: loadDict
methods.description: Loads and parses the configuration dictionary from the file.

methods.name: saveDict
methods.description: Saves the provided dictionary as the configuration file with metadata auditing.

methods.name: loadGatewayDict
methods.description: Retrieves the 'gateway' sub-dictionary from the configuration.

methods.name: updateGatewayDict
methods.description: Updates the 'gateway' sub-dictionary with a mutation closure.

methods.name: browserControlEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether browser control is enabled from the configuration.

methods.name: setBrowserControlEnabled
methods.description: Sets whether browser control is enabled in the configuration.

methods.name: gatewayPassword
methods.description: Retrieves the gateway remote password from the configuration.

methods.name: gatewayPort
methods.description: Returns the port number for the gateway.

methods.name: remoteGatewayPort
methods.description: Returns the port number from the remote gateway URL if available.

methods.name: setRemoteGatewayUrl
methods.description: Sets the remote gateway URL with specified host and port.

methods.name: clearRemoteGatewayUrl
methods.description: Removes the remote gateway URL from the configuration.

methods.name: hostKey
methods.description: Generates a normalized key for a hostname, used for comparison and matching.

methods.name: readConfigFingerprint
methods.description: Computes and returns a fingerprint (hash) and metadata of a config file.

methods.name: observeConfigRead
methods.description: Audits and logs configuration file read operations, detecting suspicious changes.
